blocking_findings: B1 [Medium] paint-splash (assets/paint-splash.ts): rating 6.5 out of 10, below the bar of 7.0. The splash reads as a scalloped badge more than as wet paint. Criteria scores from 1 to 5: brief match 4, silhouette 3, proportion and appeal 3, shape language 3, value and colour 3, materials 3, detail hierarchy 3, technical quality 3, game readiness 4, readability at 128 px 3.5. (1) The foot box is 0.04 m deep and the paint is 0.025 m thick, so the foot shows as a rectangular tab on the front face and the back face (assets/paint-splash.ts:92-93; bottom centre of out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props/paint-splash/front.png; sprite S). (2) Each lobe disc joins with smoothUnion k 0.004 (assets/paint-splash.ts:72), so every lobe leaves a ring on the face; the studio light turns the rings into bubble-like highlights in the front cutout. (3) The paint is one flat mid-value colour with no rim shade; the mean colour of the front cutout is #f3635c against the preset #d9443a, so the front reads pale coral, and the three-quarter cutout (#f04f44) reads as red. (4) The side is a 0.04 m slab (sprites W and E). The three preset renders differ in colour (red, blue, yellow), so that part of the brief is met. Suggested change for the maker: make the foot no deeper than 0.025 m or hide it inside the paint; join the lobes with k 0.02 to 0.03 so the rings vanish; add a darker rim or a vertex shade for value; then rebuild the GLB, the cutouts, and the card. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green)
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Medium] sun and flower (the tool that cuts the PNG files): the front cutout of the sun has a 1 px seam at row 569 over 600 px of the disc, at alpha 170 of 255 (out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props/sun/front.png, rows 568 and 570 are 255). On a sky blue backdrop it shows as a grey hairline above the eyes. The flower front cutout has the same seam over 66 px at the top of the petals. The older easel front cutout has it at row 569 too. The week 1 cast cutouts (1024 x 1200) have no such seam, so the cause is the 1024 x 1024 canvas path, not the sun or flower shape. cutout-check cannot see it, because worstDrop measures only the dark halo on the edge (scripts/cutout-check.mjs:85-116). The seam is a visible defect, so it caps the sun at 7.0. Suggested change: the owner of the cutout command fixes the row 569 seam, adds a seam test to cutout-check, and the maker re-cuts sun, flower, and easel before Phase 6.

N2 [Low] flower base (assets/flower.ts:57): the mound is sdf.sphere(0.04) at y 0.04, so the half-space cut at y 0 removes nothing and the mound is a full ball, 0.077 m tall in front.png. briefs/flower.md says it is 'a hemisphere of r 0.04 m, flat at y = 0'. That statement is false. The ball reads as a lollipop base under a thin stem. A second small defect: the round top of the stem shows as a tiny green blip under the yellow centre in the front cutout (stem to y 0.355 m, centre sphere r 0.03 m at y 0.37 m, head tilted back 10 degrees). Suggested change: centre the mound sphere at y 0 and fix the brief sentence, or keep the ball and fix the sentence.

N4 [Nit] grape-bunch: the leaf reads as a five-pointed star on the stem (front.png, sprite S); the maker says so in the brief and keeps the brief's five points. The bunch itself reads as grapes: 16 glossy purple spheres with a value variation. Suggested change: five rounded lobes for the leaf and a stronger taper in a later pass. cutout-check shows worstDrop 100 percent for both views; the file passes because dark edge pixels are under 10 percent of the edge, but the leaf rim deserves a look at the re-cut.
